diagnosis: The Single Logout handler receives a SAML SLO request and revokes sessions matching pattern session:*:{name_id}:* across all organizations and tenants in Redis without checking whether the IdP issuing the logout request matches the issuer of those sessions. An IdP administrator from one tenant can trigger an SLO that terminates active sessions of users in entirely different organizations.
